Name: Holiday Shop Music
Author: nancyxdrewx
Description: Adds two festive music tracks to Pierre's and Joja Mart for winter. They alternate between days. Configs include playing all winter or just the last week (last week option true by default) as well as both shops or just Joja Mart. There is a bonus realistic config for those with extra holiday spirit. ❄︎

Downloads.Description: Adds cheer to your holiday shopping.
